name: Photonic
tagline: Hologram layers floating off a dark tablet screen — transparent panes lit at the rim
source: derived from the user's Figma reference (fileKey 4tEWhmZzpqWsjjwJrqS8lg, node 4:2 "Glowy stuff") — the same node the holographic kit was taken from, read the other way: its measured light (a ~30% neutral film in multiply over the ground = ground x 0.88, a 1-3px saturated rim, inset 2px 4px 10px 4px inward bleed, 0 0 8px 4px outward bloom, a 14px honeycomb weave) is kept rather than re-expressed as hard-banded foil
use_when: projected and in-world interfaces — sci-fi, space and hardware product pages, HUD and telemetry overlays, ambient status displays, AI and vision marketing, anything that should look lit from its own edges rather than printed
